countdown.purpose: The Focus clock only; light weight keeps a large number calm.

headline.purpose: Each page's one-sentence headline: the launcher sentence, 'just logged ...', '5 tasks to do, ...', '... in the last 7 days'; 1.875rem on phones, 2.25rem from 640px.

connector.purpose: Newsreader italic, the words that join a sentence only: 'focus for', 'on', 'of', 'just logged', 'paused on'.

title.purpose: The day line above the launcher ('Tuesday evening, Maya · 1 due today'), and the Journal's week summary.

body.purpose: Status lines, lists and help text.

label.purpose: Uppercase captions on Focus and in menus, in steel-600.

shadows.name: resting-paper
shadows.purpose: Dashboard cards resting on the desk.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers and dialogs above the page.

shadows.name: focus-card
shadows.purpose: Setup and ending cards on the Focus canvas.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and state changes.

motion.name: meter-band-in
motion.purpose: A newly saved session's ink grows into the 'a'.

motion.name: meter-ghost
motion.value: transform 420ms ease-out, opacity 200ms ease-out; fades in after 1200ms following a save
motion.purpose: The ghost of the next session eases to a new length and deepens while Begin is pointed at.

components.name: Begin Button
components.description: The dashboard's one filled button, in the subject's colour (Baltic by default).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-begin"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><polygon points="3,2 12,7 3,12" fill="currentColor"/></svg>Begin focusing</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-begin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; background: #60729f; color: #ffffff; font: 500 15px/1.2 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(38,45,64,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-begin:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-begin:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-begin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled Deep Baltic pill for the main action on Focus and in dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 24px; background: #4d5b80; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #394460; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White pill with a hairline edge for secondary actions (Finish early, Pause & leave).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #c5c9d3; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #394460; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0f1f4; border-color: #a8aebd; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined quiet alternative to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-link { border: none; background: none; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 6px; color: #616b6b; font: 500 14px/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #afb6b6; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: #394460; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #60729f; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field with a 3:1 edge; focus uses the shared outline.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">Your name</label><input id="ds-name" class="ds-input" placeholder="What should we call you?" />
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #394460; } .ds-input { width: 280px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #8b93a7; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #262d40; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #616b6b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #808eb3; outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(197,201,211,.6); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(38,45,64,.04), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(38,45,64,.06), 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(38,45,64,.10); } .ds-card-sentence { margin: 0; font: 700 36px/1.15 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #262d40; } .ds-card-sentence i { font: italic 400 1.08em 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0; padding-right: 0.06em; color: #4d5b80; } .ds-card-sentence b { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.06em; text-underline-offset: 0.16em; text-decoration-color: #8b93a7; }

components.name: Page Navigation
components.description: Plain page names in the top bar, which is the desk colour with a hairline; the current page in dark ink with a 2px rule under its name.
components.html: DashboardTasksFocusJournal
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px 13px; background: #eff1f5; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(197,201,211,0.8); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #616b6b; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #394460; } .ds-nav-active { color: #262d40; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4d5b80; } .ds-nav-active:hover { color: #262d40; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Text-only pill for the Tasks filter and the task form's Subject and Priority; the selected one fills Baltic Selected. Session lengths are picked from a sentence's length list, not chips.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: #616b6b; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #394460; } .ds-chip-on { background: #dfe3ec; color: #394460; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sentence Slot
components.description: A word of a headline sentence, underlined like a blank, that opens a short list of choices under itself: the launcher's length and task, the Focus card's length and subject (with New subject…), Settings' goal and length. Every length list ends with Other length…; the last word and its chevron never part.
components.html: aim for a day, at a time
components.css: .ds-sentence { margin: 0; font: 700 36px/1.15 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #262d40; } .ds-connect { font: italic 400 1.08em 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0; color: #4d5b80; } .ds-slot { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: none; padding: 0 4px; margin: 0 -4px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #8b93a7; text-decoration-thickness: 0.06em; text-underline-offset: 0.16em; } .ds-slot:hover { background: #e2e4e9; text-decoration-color: #60729f; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: The armed second step of an action that can't be undone (Clear everything), shown only after a first click, beside a ghost way out that takes focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #b91c1c; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #fef2f2; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Storage Notice
components.description: Fixed to the bottom of every page once the browser refuses to keep aim's data; dismissible.
components.html: This browser isn't saving aim. Tasks and sessions from this tab will be gone when it closes. Allowing site data for this site fixes it.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; max-width: 576px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: #262d40; color: #ffffff; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px -12px rgba(38,45,64,0.28); } .ds-notice strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-notice-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f87171; } .ds-notice p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Undo Banner
components.description: A Baltic pill in a reserved row under the Tasks list: what just happened and one action. Undo for Marked done or Deleted; Show for a new task the open tab doesn't hold ("Added to Science."). Five seconds of visible time, held while pointed at or focused.
components.html: Added to Science.Titration write-up
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 420px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #394460; color: #ffffff; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38,45,64,0.12); } .ds-banner-what { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-banner svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: #c7ce64; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-banner strong { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-banner-title { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); } .ds-banner-action { border: none; background: none; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: #d5da8b; font: 700 12px/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-banner-action:hover { color: #e3e7b1; } .ds-banner-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(199,206,100,0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Focus Rating
components.description: Four circles on the ending card, Scattered to Deep focus, each filled to its level. Unpicked fills are the meter's pale ghost ink, so none reads as already chosen; the pick fills in full ink with a halo. The Journal draws a saved rating the same way, in that one ink at every level.
components.css: .ds-rating { display: inline-flex; gap: 16px; } .ds-rating button { border: none; background: none; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rating svg { display: block; width: 36px; height: 36px; } .ds-rating .ring { fill: none; stroke: #8b93a7; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-rating .fill { fill: rgba(57,68,96,0.14); transition: fill 150ms ease-out; } .ds-rating button:hover { background: #f0f1f4; } .ds-rating button:hover .fill { fill: rgba(57,68,96,0.3); } .ds-rating [aria-pressed="true"] { background: #eff1f5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(128,142,179,0.4); } .ds-rating [aria-pressed="true"] .fill { fill: #4d5b80; } .ds-rating [aria-pressed="true"] .ring { stroke: #60729f; } .ds-rating button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60729f; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
aim looks like study material annotated in the margins, kept calm. White paper cards with a faint grain rest on a pale blue-grey desk. The words that join a sentence ("focus for", "on", "just logged") are set in an italic serif, like a note in a textbook's margin, while what matters (the task, the length, the time) is set in a clear grotesque. The day's progress fills the "a" of the logo like ink.

The north star describes what is already there; it is not a licence to add notebook props. The system is quiet by default: one card, one sentence, one filled button per screen, and everything else steps back. Focus, where the session runs, is the same desk with the furniture cleared away, keeping only the clock, the controls and an optional slow backdrop.

The rejected direction is the generic productivity dashboard: grids of same-size stat cards, competing accents, decoration added to fill space. It was tried, felt AI-generated and overwhelming, and was taken out.
keyCharacteristics: A sentence as the headline: what matters in a bold grotesque, the words that join it in an italic serif.
Paper cards with soft, layered shadows on a pale blue-grey surface.
One filled, fully rounded primary button per screen, coloured by the subject.
Colour carries meaning: a subject's colour, the ink in the "a", the primary action.
Light theme only for now; motion is slow, optional, and off under "reduce motion".

rules.name: The Reason Rule
rules.body: Every visual change states the reason it serves (a finding, a user need, a measured problem). A change that only makes something look more like a notebook does not ship.

rules.name: The Subject Colour Rule
rules.body: A subject's colour appears where that subject is: its dot (in task lists and the launcher), the Begin button for it. It is never used decoratively. The "a" itself fills in one ink, the logo's colour, not in subject colours, so the subjects listed under it have no dots: there was nothing in the letter for a dot to match (critique, 2026-10-28).

rules.name: The Connecting Words Rule
rules.body: The italic serif only joins the words of a sentence. It never carries content, a number or a control label.

rules.name: The One Filled Button Rule
rules.body: Each screen has exactly one filled primary button. Everything else is a secondary pill, an underlined text link or a plain row.

rules.name: The Rest and Float Rule
rules.body: Things on the page rest; only things above the page float. A card never gets a floating shadow.

dos: Do give every visual change a stated reason (The Reason Rule).
Do keep exactly one filled button per screen (The One Filled Button Rule).
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better (steel-600 on white is the floor) and control edges and icons at 3:1 (lavender-400).
Do use the shared baltic-500 focus outline; a custom ring must use the same colour.
Do honour "reduce motion": animated backdrops don't start and entrance animations are off.

Do let long text wrap or truncate, never overflow: a task title can be 120 characters with no spaces. Headlines, the day line and dialog titles break anywhere if they must; single-line rows truncate; initials come from the first whole character.
donts: Don't add notebook props (tape, doodles, ruled lines, stickers) to express the north star.
Don't set content, numbers or controls in the italic serif (The Connecting Words Rule).
Don't use a subject colour decoratively (The Subject Colour Rule).
Don't use dark surfaces; aim is light-only until dark mode is deliberately brought back.
Don't return to grids of same-size stat cards or competing accents; that is the direction aim moved away from.
Don't use emoji or Unicode symbols as icons; icons are inline SVG with a 1.5 to 1.75 stroke.
